title: Deep learning detects papilledema on handheld-camera retinal photographs
summary: A deep learning system trained on 18,981 mydriatic retinal photographs from 22 countries segmented the optic disc and classified papilledema, other optic neuropathies and normal discs. On 1,552 prospectively collected handheld-camera photographs from 817 patients it reached 99.5% accuracy. Further metrics are not available here.
